run_challenge_submission: run the script to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from results
write_is2re_relaxations_from_traj: write IS2RE relaxation predictions from trajectory files in a directory to a compressed NPZ submission file
write_is2re_relaxations_hybrid: write IS2RE predictions from hybrid S2EF NPZ prediction files with force and energy models
write_predictions: write S2EF or IS2RE predictions from an NPZ results file to a challenge submission NPZ file
create_submission_from_cli: create a challenge submission file using CLI args for path, output path, and relaxation mode
